name: Council Vagn

facts.text: Vagn is a level-78 Council member with 100,000 health, linked to Council Nokkvi: pull one and both come.
A 2005 Allakhazam comment says the pair resisted every spell and the tanks hit Nokkvi for almost nothing; someone had to kite Vagn.
Old Norse vagn means wagon, and nokkvi a kind of boat (both to verify).

story:
Vagn and Nokkvi are named for a wagon and a boat, because in the Council's early days they carried everything between them: the votes, the gossip, the grudges, the queen's wishes down to the outer seats and the outer seats' complaints back up to the ribs. A wagon on the ice and a boat on the water, the joke went; between them, nothing in Tuscaran went undelivered. They still go everywhere together. They sit side by side in the outer council hall, their seats worn alike, and where one is seen the other is never far.

Vagn is the talker. He has opinions about everything and shares them freely: about the Icelords' manners, about Otrygg's kennel, about Hord's endless mending, about the queen's choice of husband, which he mentions only when Tuscar is far away. He has a frost shock to end an argument with, a bolt of cold that hits for more than most giants' fists, and he uses it on whoever is casting, because in his view a caster is someone who argues from a distance.

Nokkvi is the one who listens and does not fall down. The Council says you cannot move one without the other, and in this the Council has rarely been more right. Pull one and both come. They argued for peace together for a hundred years, and they will die together, and neither would have it any other way. When one falls, the other grieves loudly and hits harder for it. Vagn's grief, as you would expect, is the louder: he wants to know who will carry the vote now.
legend: Vagn and Nokkvi come as a pair and have huge resists. One group kites or holds Vagn while the raid works Nokkvi, or the reverse. Don't stand casters in Vagn's frost shock range; he picks casters. When one dies the other grieves loudly and hits harder for it, so have the second kill planned before the first one drops. Both reset if dragged past their tether or left out of combat for half a minute. Vagn likes to talk; the council's pair are the cleanest test of whether a raid can split itself. Interrupt his frost shocks if you can.

loremasterTopic.text: A wagon and a boat, the Council named him and [Nokkvi], because they carried everything between them. They still go everywhere together. Vagn talks; Nokkvi does not fall down.

bookPage: From the sculptor's account of the Council. Vagn spoke on every question. On the morvalt: a nuisance. On the dwarves: a smaller nuisance. On the Icelords: a large nuisance with good manners when it suits them. On the queen's husband: nothing, while the king was in earshot, and a great deal otherwise. Nokkvi spoke on no question at all. When the vote was called, Vagn raised his hand, and Nokkvi raised his, and that was two votes for whatever Vagn had said. The sculptor said he carved them together, as one block, and that it was the only carving of his the Council ever liked.
